import YulangClosure.HigherOrderSyntax
import YulangClosure.CoreSubstitution

namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrder

mutual
  def renameValue (r : Nat → Nat) : Value → Value
    | .var i => .var (r i)
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (renameComp r m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (renameValue r v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (renameValue r v)
    | .both v => .both (renameValue r v)
    | .top v => .top (renameValue r v)
    | .view v o => .view (renameValue r v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (renameComp (Original.up r) body) (renameAdapter r consumer)
    | .wrap f input output => .wrap (renameValue r f) (renameAdapter r input) (renameAdapter r output)
  def renameComp (r : Nat → Nat) : Comp → Comp
    | .ret v => .ret (renameValue r v)
    | .force v => .force (renameValue r v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (renameValue r v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (renameValue r v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (renameValue r v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (renameComp r m) (renameComp (Original.up r) n)
    | .unionCase v l right => .unionCase (renameValue r v) (renameComp (Original.up r) l) (renameComp (Original.up r) right)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (renameComp r body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (renameComp r body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (renameValue r v) (renameComp (Original.up r) k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall f a => .dynamicCall (renameValue r f) (renameValue r a)
  def renameAdapter (r : Nat → Nat) : Adapter → Adapter
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (renameComp (Original.up r) body) paths views
end

def lift (s : Nat → Value) : Nat → Value
  | 0 => .var 0
  | n+1 => renameValue Nat.succ (s n)

mutual
  def substValue (s : Nat → Value) : Value → Value
    | .var i => s i
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (substComp s m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (substValue s v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (substValue s v)
    | .both v => .both (substValue s v)
    | .top v => .top (substValue s v)
    | .view v o => .view (substValue s v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (substComp (lift s) body) (substAdapter s consumer)
    | .wrap f input output => .wrap (substValue s f) (substAdapter s input) (substAdapter s output)
  def substComp (s : Nat → Value) : Comp → Comp
    | .ret v => .ret (substValue s v)
    | .force v => .force (substValue s v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (substValue s v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (substValue s v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (substValue s v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (substComp s m) (substComp (lift s) n)
    | .unionCase v l r => .unionCase (substValue s v) (substComp (lift s) l) (substComp (lift s) r)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (substComp s body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (substComp s body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (substValue s v) (substComp (lift s) k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall f a => .dynamicCall (substValue s f) (substValue s a)
  def substAdapter (s : Nat → Value) : Adapter → Adapter
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (substComp (lift s) body) paths views
end

def RenamingTyped (env target : Context) (r : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, env i = some a → target (r i) = some a

theorem up_typed (h : RenamingTyped env target r) (a : Ty) :
    RenamingTyped (extend env a) (extend target a) (Original.up r) := by
  intro i b hi
  cases i with
  | zero => exact hi
  | succ i => exact h i b hi

mutual
  theorem renameValue_typed (h : ValueTyped env v a) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      ValueTyped target (renameValue r v) a := by
    cases h with
    | var h => exact .var (ht _ _ h)
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | top h => exact .top (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | view h => exact .view (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | both h k => exact .both (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameValue_typed k ht)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _)) (renameAdapter_typed k ht)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _)) (renameAdapter_typed k ht)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameAdapter_typed i ht) (renameAdapter_typed o ht)
  theorem renameComp_typed (h : CompTyped env m a) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      CompTyped target (renameComp r m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | force h => exact .force (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (renameComp_typed h ht) (renameComp_typed k (up_typed ht _))
    | unionCase h l r => exact .unionCase (renameValue_typed h ht)
        (renameComp_typed l (up_typed ht _)) (renameComp_typed r (up_typed ht _))
    | scope h => exact .scope (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | expose h => exact .expose (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | request h k => exact .request (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameComp_typed k (up_typed ht _))
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameValue_typed k ht)
  theorem renameAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped env adapter a b) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      AdapterTyped target (renameAdapter r adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _))
end

def SubstitutionTyped (env target : Context) (s : Nat → Value) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, env i = some a → ValueTyped target (s i) a

theorem lift_typed (h : SubstitutionTyped env target s) (a : Ty) :
    SubstitutionTyped (extend env a) (extend target a) (lift s) := by
  intro i b hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst b
      exact .var rfl
  | succ i => exact renameValue_typed (h i b hi) (fun _ _ h => h)

mutual
  theorem substValue_typed (h : ValueTyped env v a) (ht : SubstitutionTyped env target s) :
      ValueTyped target (substValue s v) a := by
    cases h with
    | var h => exact ht _ _ h
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (substComp_typed h ht)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (substValue_typed h ht)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (substValue_typed h ht)
    | top h => exact .top (substValue_typed h ht)
    | view h => exact .view (substValue_typed h ht)
    | both h k => exact .both (substValue_typed h ht) (substValue_typed k ht)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _)) (substAdapter_typed k ht)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _)) (substAdapter_typed k ht)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (substValue_typed h ht) (substAdapter_typed i ht) (substAdapter_typed o ht)
  theorem substComp_typed (h : CompTyped env m a) (ht : SubstitutionTyped env target s) :
      CompTyped target (substComp s m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (substValue_typed h ht)
    | force h => exact .force (substValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (substValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (substValue_typed h ht)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (substValue_typed h ht)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (substComp_typed h ht) (substComp_typed k (lift_typed ht _))
    | unionCase h l r => exact .unionCase (substValue_typed h ht)
        (substComp_typed l (lift_typed ht _)) (substComp_typed r (lift_typed ht _))
    | scope h => exact .scope (substComp_typed h ht)
    | expose h => exact .expose (substComp_typed h ht)
    | request h k => exact .request (substValue_typed h ht) (substComp_typed k (lift_typed ht _))
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (substValue_typed h ht) (substValue_typed k ht)
  theorem substAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped env adapter a b) (ht : SubstitutionTyped env target s) :
      AdapterTyped target (substAdapter s adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _))
end

def single (v : Value) : Nat → Value
  | 0 => v
  | n+1 => .var n

theorem substitute_top (hb : CompTyped (extend env a) body b) (hv : ValueTyped env v a) :
    CompTyped env (substComp (single v) body) b := by
  apply substComp_typed hb
  intro i t hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst t
      exact hv
  | succ i => exact .var hi

/-- The result consumer belongs to the outer context; its own binder is lifted
by substAdapter exactly once. Types, receipt, paths and views are unchanged. -/
theorem substitute_lambda (s : Nat → Value) (mode receipt a b r body consumer) :
    substValue s (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer) =
      .lambda mode receipt a b r (substComp (lift s) body) (substAdapter s consumer) := rfl

theorem substitute_adapter (s : Nat → Value) (a b body paths views) :
    substAdapter s (.mk a b body paths views) =
      .mk a b (substComp (lift s) body) paths views := rfl

theorem substitute_request (s : Nat → Value) (op payload continuation) :
    substComp s (.request op payload continuation) =
      .request op (substValue s payload) (substComp (lift s) continuation) := rfl

end YulangClosure.HigherOrder

# Higher-order substitution, capture and entry: source map

Date: 2026-10-25
Baseline: `98118c2933694a03fcbf443a4cd638e350f76394`.
Scope: checked research core typing constructions; full source/native adequacy OPEN.
Contract: `tasks/agent-loop/sprints/higher-order-substitution-entry-20261025-r1.md`.
Verification and independent review are recorded in the sprint outcome/receipts.
The previous independently reviewed constructor inventory is
`notes/theory/2026-10-25-higher-order-source-constructor-map.md`; its exact bytes
and all native source dependencies are pinned in this contract.

## 1. New parent application and its limit

The preceding milestone embedded old Functions as genuine HigherOrder.Value
callables. This packet supplies capture-avoiding substitution for the entire
higher-order grammar, then consumes a constructed callable in an actual generic
current-cell read, finite capture realization and body-closing operation. The
selected endpoint must discharge that constructed store's cell typing using
`embedFunction_typed`, rather than assume arbitrary native cells are typed.

The general theorem remains conditional on successful current reads, a correct
finite layout and typing of those represented current values. The concrete
fresh-cell/callable application supplies its read and cell-typing hypotheses.
This is a real instance of the new supplier, not readback of a Rust Closure.
The source-to-layout map, native ReceivedValue interpretation and shared/recursive
closure graph are distinct OPEN premises. A direct cell Reference used for a
fresh generic store address does not assert that a local cell is a source
ModuleDef or belongs to the native preallocated global definition table.

## 2. Exact binder ownership

The immutable accepted HigherOrder typing rules are the authority for these
research algebraic proofs. The syntax contains value-variable binders only;
this packet does not claim type-variable/polymorphic substitution or full Raw
binder coverage. Value substitution leaves types and operation instances intact,
including every ordered type argument, receipt, path and view occurrence.

| Position | Environment used by its typing rule | Transformation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lambda body, Value mode | extend outer A | Lift through one parameter binder. |
| lambda body, Computation mode | extend outer (Thunk A) | Same index lifting, distinct bound type. |
| lambda result consumer | outer | Transform the Adapter in the outer substitution; no lambda-parameter lift. |
| Adapter body | extend outer input | Adapter itself introduces exactly one input binder. |
| bind body | extend outer first-result | Lift once; first computation uses outer substitution. |
| unionCase branches | extend outer left / extend outer right | Lift each branch separately. |
| request continuation | extend outer response type | Lift once; payload uses outer substitution. |
| wrap inner/input/output | outer | Inner value and both adapters use the same outer substitution; adapter bodies lift themselves. |
| delay, view, scope, expose, dynamicCall | outer | Recurse through their actual value/code children, retaining metadata. |

The critical nested-lambda case has two different index-zero meanings. Index zero
inside the lambda body is its parameter; index zero inside its consumer's body
is the consumer input. The consumer does not capture the lambda parameter. For
example, an outer value referenced by index one in each body is replaced once
in each case; lifting the consumer once for the lambda and again for the adapter
would mistakenly retain or capture the wrong variable.

Closed Original nodes in old TypedCall syntax were protected from old Call
rename/substitution. The new structural embedding exposes their internal terms.
Thus an untyped old `.original (.var 0)` is a concrete counterexample to an
unconditional old/new commuting equation: old Call substitution leaves it intact,
while target substitution changes its image `.var 0`. Old typing excludes that
open Original term through its empty-context premise. No accepted old theorem
is weakened, and no unrestricted commuting theorem is asserted here.

## 3. Native lookup and substitution are different operations

Paths in this section are under `tools/inference-playground/src/runtime/`.
The reviewed NativeClosureEnvironment construction already establishes finite
nearest-binder lookup, old-environment address stability and fresh Store.push
observation. `machine.rs:2585–2638` is the actual lookup/append/bind owner.
Lookup follows immutable parent indices to a full binder identity, returns a
cell address, and the Name consumer at 781–862 reads its CURRENT ReceivedValue.
Cells can be filled after closure formation, including recursive initialization.

The native function named `substitute_environment` at 2606 is not syntactic
value substitution. It composes dictionary dispatch substitutions and optionally
appends a binder-free environment node. It neither rewrites code nor replaces
lexical values. The new de Bruijn substitution is a mathematical interpretation
of successful lexical capture; its native adequacy requires the source layout
and current-cell relation. Conflating these two operations would leave the
central body/environment premise unproved.

`ReceivedValue` at machine.rs:165 contains value handle, interface, receiving
view and optional dispatch. New generic Store cells contain already represented
HigherOrder.Value. A proof about the latter does not erase or validate the former
fields. Their source representation/typing remains ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 and
ENV-DISPATCH-1; finite lexical addresses alone do not solve recursive value graphs.

## 4. Callee-first Apply and entry modes

`program.rs:852–857` retains both callee and argument code labels. Native
`Instruction::Apply` at machine.rs:888–900 evaluates callee after pushing the
argument and caller environment. `Frame::Callee` at 1181–1201 allocates an inert
Delay of the whole argument in the CALLER environment, then selects the actual
returned executable. The closure branch at 1224–1329 enters the SAVED closure
environment after dispatch substitution. The previous inventory covers each field.

The corresponding research computation is structurally

```
bind callee (dynamicCall (var 0) (delay (rename argument Nat.succ)))
```

Here `argument` is a computation typed in the original surrounding context.
The shift places every original free value index beyond the new callee binder;
all binders within argument code lift that shift. This construction retains an
inert delay rather than placing argument execution before the callee bind.
Its theorem proves typing of this actual term. It is not a complete source Apply
elaboration or a proof about native request/suffix traces.

Value entry pushes ValueEntry and executes the delayed argument; when it returns,
ordinary parameter binding at machine.rs:1476 uses that received value. A typed
force/bind composition models this formal body's A parameter. Computation entry
at 1298–1329 binds the carrier itself at Thunk A and immediately evaluates its
body; formal substitution of the UNFORCED carrier models that body entry.
There is no extra force in that construction. A body may later force its formal.

`Frame::ValueEntry:1438–1488` also validates callback schema/owner/identity/interface,
handles unit patterns without an ordinary parameter cell, and delegates record
patterns. `RecordDefault:1489–1498` and `bind_record_parameter:2655–2689` preserve
sequential field/default scope. These cases require source pattern/body elaboration
and metadata evidence before a single-binder formal body applies. The research
proof adds no source restriction and does not silently claim those checks succeed.

## 5. Result consumers and wrap projections

The accepted old formal entry supplier is `CallEntryTypingRepair.lean`;
`CallPeelingTyping.lean` tracks wrap argument delays and ordered result adapters.
The historical failed `CallEntryTyping.lean` is not an accepted proof dependency.
The new higher-order constructions use the actual Adapter body under its own
input binder and preserve the c→a argument / b→d result directions around a→b.
A delayed input-adapter composition must remain under delay; result consumption
follows the invocation body's result. Existing receipt, paths and captured views
remain attached to the retained adapter/entry plan.

Native `ExecutableValue` has Closure/Delay/Request/Continuation/Primitive cases,
not a direct Wrap case. There is no established all-source map from every formal
wrap/result consumer to that native enumeration. `Frame::ReceiverReturn` at
machine.rs:1430–1437 leaves the invocation owner and transports the returned
ReceivedValue; this fact alone does not execute or certify an arbitrary formal
result adapter. Correspondence with actual source-generated adapter plans and
receiving/dispatch transitions remains OPEN.

Accordingly, typed body projections are computations inside the research model,
with full original adapter/receipt data retained by their plan. No body-typing
lemma grants runtime metadata erasure, supplies fresh invocation/receipt identities,
or proves owner retirement, continuation replay or dispatch error exclusion.
The paper remains a proposal; no new production semantics is adopted.

## 6. Remaining gates and next concrete consumers

- HO-SUBSTITUTION-1 can close for the accepted HigherOrder finite grammar only
  after all mutual cases and lifts check and pass independent review.
- The constructed callable-cell/body theorem supplies one genuine instance of
  ENV-CALLABLE-1's body-closing input. Arbitrary native Closure/Delay current-cell
  readback, complete layouts and recursive graphs remain ENV-LAYOUT-1,
  ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 and ENV-GRAPH-1, at program/body/initialization owners.
- Typed force/bind, computation entry, consumer/wrap and source Apply expressions
  are not a full HigherOrder operational machine. Progress/preservation for
  actual transitions and all source/native trace correspondence remain OPEN.
- ENV-DISPATCH-1 and RESPONSE-TEMPLATE-1 still require typed receiving/dispatch/
  frame interpretation and errors exclusion beyond the reviewed structural
  environment/template suppliers. Force and original inference A/B retain their
  original scope and owners.

NO_SAFE_CODE_SLICE: the inspected Callee and ValueEntry/Computation owners expose
no demonstrated runtime defect. No compiler/runtime/expectation/config change or
native test is authorized by this proof packet.

# Higher-order research core and structural embedding

Status: Draft research construction; checking and review evidence is recorded in
the sprint outcome and its frozen receipts. This is not production authority.
Scope: frozen LEAN-HIGHER-ORDER-PROOF-CORE-20261025/r1 research representation.
Initial author: /root/higher_order_proof_core_astra_r1; requested gpt-6-astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value
encoding), ENV-GRAPH-1 (recursive cell/closure graphs), ENV-CALLABLE-1's remaining
native body/consumer mapping, and ENV-DISPATCH-1. Relevant native owners remain
machine.rs `Instruction::Lambda`, `Frame::ValueEntry`, `Machine::lookup`,
`Machine::extend`, closure/Callee branches and receiving.rs lambda schema
construction. The primary's disjoint source map gives their complete exact
producer/consumer inventory, including unit/record/default entry cases.
Force, native transitions, new-core substitution/progress/preservation,
whole-trace safety, operation authenticity and original inference A/B remain
OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.

## Intake and checks

No Lean/build/tests/native checks were run by the author. A shell `python`
invocation failed because the executable was absent; the generation was then
performed with python3. This was a file-writing failure before any write, not a
failed proof check. Primary owns bounded elaboration, public signature/axiom
inspection, distinguishing examples, repairs after author STOP and fresh
independent review. Author/coauthor cannot independently certify this candidate.
Only the four exact leased files were created; there are no scratch paths,
background processes, descendants, compiler changes or Git operations.

import YulangClosure.HigherOrderSyntax
import YulangClosure.CoreSubstitution

namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrder

mutual
  def renameValue (r : Nat → Nat) : Value → Value
    | .var i => .var (r i)
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (renameComp r m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (renameValue r v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (renameValue r v)
    | .both v => .both (renameValue r v)
    | .top v => .top (renameValue r v)
    | .view v o => .view (renameValue r v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (renameComp (Original.up r) body) (renameAdapter r consumer)
    | .wrap f input output => .wrap (renameValue r f) (renameAdapter r input) (renameAdapter r output)
  def renameComp (r : Nat → Nat) : Comp → Comp
    | .ret v => .ret (renameValue r v)
    | .force v => .force (renameValue r v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (renameValue r v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (renameValue r v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (renameValue r v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (renameComp r m) (renameComp (Original.up r) n)
    | .unionCase v l right => .unionCase (renameValue r v) (renameComp (Original.up r) l) (renameComp (Original.up r) right)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (renameComp r body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (renameComp r body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (renameValue r v) (renameComp (Original.up r) k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall f a => .dynamicCall (renameValue r f) (renameValue r a)
  def renameAdapter (r : Nat → Nat) : Adapter → Adapter
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (renameComp (Original.up r) body) paths views
end

def lift (s : Nat → Value) : Nat → Value
  | 0 => .var 0
  | n+1 => renameValue Nat.succ (s n)

mutual
  def substValue (s : Nat → Value) : Value → Value
    | .var i => s i
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay m => .delay (substComp s m)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (substValue s v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (substValue s v)
    | .both v => .both (substValue s v)
    | .top v => .top (substValue s v)
    | .view v o => .view (substValue s v) o
    | .lambda mode receipt a b c body consumer =>
        .lambda mode receipt a b c (substComp (lift s) body) (substAdapter s consumer)
    | .wrap f input output => .wrap (substValue s f) (substAdapter s input) (substAdapter s output)
  def substComp (s : Nat → Value) : Comp → Comp
    | .ret v => .ret (substValue s v)
    | .force v => .force (substValue s v)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (substValue s v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (substValue s v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (substValue s v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (substComp s m) (substComp (lift s) n)
    | .unionCase v l r => .unionCase (substValue s v) (substComp (lift s) l) (substComp (lift s) r)
    | .scope owner body => .scope owner (substComp s body)
    | .expose ev rv body => .expose ev rv (substComp s body)
    | .request op v k => .request op (substValue s v) (substComp (lift s) k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
    | .dynamicCall f a => .dynamicCall (substValue s f) (substValue s a)
  def substAdapter (s : Nat → Value) : Adapter → Adapter
    | .mk a b body paths views => .mk a b (substComp (lift s) body) paths views
end

def RenamingTyped (env target : Context) (r : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, env i = some a → target (r i) = some a

theorem up_typed (h : RenamingTyped env target r) (a : Ty) :
    RenamingTyped (extend env a) (extend target a) (Original.up r) := by
  intro i b hi
  cases i with
  | zero => exact hi
  | succ i => exact h i b hi

mutual
  theorem renameValue_typed (h : ValueTyped env v a) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      ValueTyped target (renameValue r v) a := by
    cases h with
    | var h => exact .var (ht _ _ h)
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | top h => exact .top (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | view h => exact .view (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | both h k => exact .both (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameValue_typed k ht)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _)) (renameAdapter_typed k ht)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _)) (renameAdapter_typed k ht)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameAdapter_typed i ht) (renameAdapter_typed o ht)
  theorem renameComp_typed (h : CompTyped env m a) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      CompTyped target (renameComp r m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | force h => exact .force (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (renameValue_typed h ht)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (renameComp_typed h ht) (renameComp_typed k (up_typed ht _))
    | unionCase h l r =>
        exact .unionCase (renameValue_typed h ht)
          (renameComp_typed l (up_typed ht _)) (renameComp_typed r (up_typed ht _))
    | scope h => exact .scope (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | expose h => exact .expose (renameComp_typed h ht)
    | request h k => exact .request (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameComp_typed k (up_typed ht _))
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (renameValue_typed h ht) (renameValue_typed k ht)
  theorem renameAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped env adapter a b) (ht : RenamingTyped env target r) :
      AdapterTyped target (renameAdapter r adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (renameComp_typed h (up_typed ht _))
end

def SubstitutionTyped (env target : Context) (s : Nat → Value) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, env i = some a → ValueTyped target (s i) a

theorem lift_typed (h : SubstitutionTyped env target s) (a : Ty) :
    SubstitutionTyped (extend env a) (extend target a) (lift s) := by
  intro i b hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst b
      exact .var rfl
  | succ i => exact renameValue_typed (h i b hi) (fun _ _ h => h)

mutual
  theorem substValue_typed (h : ValueTyped env v a) (ht : SubstitutionTyped env target s) :
      ValueTyped target (substValue s v) a := by
    cases h with
    | var h => exact ht _ _ h
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (substComp_typed h ht)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (substValue_typed h ht)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (substValue_typed h ht)
    | top h => exact .top (substValue_typed h ht)
    | view h => exact .view (substValue_typed h ht)
    | both h k => exact .both (substValue_typed h ht) (substValue_typed k ht)
    | lambdaValue h k => exact .lambdaValue (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _)) (substAdapter_typed k ht)
    | lambdaComputation h k => exact .lambdaComputation (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _)) (substAdapter_typed k ht)
    | wrap h i o => exact .wrap (substValue_typed h ht) (substAdapter_typed i ht) (substAdapter_typed o ht)
  theorem substComp_typed (h : CompTyped env m a) (ht : SubstitutionTyped env target s) :
      CompTyped target (substComp s m) a := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (substValue_typed h ht)
    | force h => exact .force (substValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (substValue_typed h ht)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (substValue_typed h ht)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (substValue_typed h ht)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (substComp_typed h ht) (substComp_typed k (lift_typed ht _))
    | unionCase h l r =>
        exact .unionCase (substValue_typed h ht)
          (substComp_typed l (lift_typed ht _)) (substComp_typed r (lift_typed ht _))
    | scope h => exact .scope (substComp_typed h ht)
    | expose h => exact .expose (substComp_typed h ht)
    | request h k => exact .request (substValue_typed h ht) (substComp_typed k (lift_typed ht _))
    | fail => exact .fail
    | dynamicCall h k => exact .dynamicCall (substValue_typed h ht) (substValue_typed k ht)
  theorem substAdapter_typed (h : AdapterTyped env adapter a b) (ht : SubstitutionTyped env target s) :
      AdapterTyped target (substAdapter s adapter) a b := by
    cases h with
    | mk h => exact .mk (substComp_typed h (lift_typed ht _))
end

def single (v : Value) : Nat → Value
  | 0 => v
  | n+1 => .var n

theorem substitute_top (hb : CompTyped (extend env a) body b) (hv : ValueTyped env v a) :
    CompTyped env (substComp (single v) body) b := by
  apply substComp_typed hb
  intro i t hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst t
      exact hv
  | succ i => exact .var hi

/-- The result consumer belongs to the outer context; its own binder is lifted
by substAdapter exactly once. Types, receipt, paths and views are unchanged. -/
theorem substitute_lambda (s : Nat → Value) (mode receipt a b r body consumer) :
    substValue s (.lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer) =
      .lambda mode receipt a b r (substComp (lift s) body) (substAdapter s consumer) := rfl

theorem substitute_adapter (s : Nat → Value) (a b body paths views) :
    substAdapter s (.mk a b body paths views) =
      .mk a b (substComp (lift s) body) paths views := rfl

theorem substitute_request (s : Nat → Value) (op payload continuation) :
    substComp s (.request op payload continuation) =
      .request op (substValue s payload) (substComp (lift s) continuation) := rfl

end YulangClosure.HigherOrder

`notes/theory/2026-10-25-higher-order-source-constructor-map.md`; its exact bytes
and all native source dependencies are pinned in this contract.

## 1. New parent application and its limit

The preceding milestone embedded old Functions as genuine HigherOrder.Value
callables. This packet supplies capture-avoiding substitution for the entire
higher-order grammar, then consumes a constructed callable in an actual generic
current-cell read, finite capture realization and body-closing operation. The
selected endpoint must discharge that constructed store's cell typing using
`embedFunction_typed`, rather than assume arbitrary native cells are typed.

The general theorem remains conditional on successful current reads, a correct
finite layout and typing of those represented current values. The concrete
fresh-cell/callable application supplies its read and cell-typing hypotheses.
This is a real instance of the new supplier, not readback of a Rust Closure.
The source-to-layout map, native ReceivedValue interpretation and shared/recursive
closure graph are distinct OPEN premises. A direct cell Reference used for a
fresh generic store address does not assert that a local cell is a source
ModuleDef or belongs to the native preallocated global definition table.

## 2. Exact binder ownership

The immutable accepted HigherOrder typing rules are the authority for these
research algebraic proofs. The syntax contains value-variable binders only;
this packet does not claim type-variable/polymorphic substitution or full Raw
binder coverage. Value substitution leaves types and operation instances intact,
including every ordered type argument, receipt, path and view occurrence.

| Position | Environment used by its typing rule | Transformation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lambda body, Value mode | extend outer A | Lift through one parameter binder. |
| lambda body, Computation mode | extend outer (Thunk A) | Same index lifting, distinct bound type. |
| lambda result consumer | outer | Transform the Adapter in the outer substitution; no lambda-parameter lift. |
| Adapter body | extend outer input | Adapter itself introduces exactly one input binder. |
| bind body | extend outer first-result | Lift once; first computation uses outer substitution. |
| unionCase branches | extend outer left / extend outer right | Lift each branch separately. |
| request continuation | extend outer response type | Lift once; payload uses outer substitution. |
| wrap inner/input/output | outer | Inner value and both adapters use the same outer substitution; adapter bodies lift themselves. |
| delay, view, scope, expose, dynamicCall | outer | Recurse through their actual value/code children, retaining metadata. |

The critical nested-lambda case has two different index-zero meanings. Index zero
inside the lambda body is its parameter; index zero inside its consumer's body
is the consumer input. The consumer does not capture the lambda parameter. For
example, an outer value referenced by index one in each body is replaced once
in each case; lifting the consumer once for the lambda and again for the adapter
would mistakenly retain or capture the wrong variable.

Closed Original nodes in old TypedCall syntax were protected from old Call
rename/substitution. The new structural embedding exposes their internal terms.
Thus an untyped old `.original (.var 0)` is a concrete counterexample to an
unconditional old/new commuting equation: old Call substitution leaves it intact,
while target substitution changes its image `.var 0`. Old typing excludes that
open Original term through its empty-context premise. No accepted old theorem
is weakened, and no unrestricted commuting theorem is asserted here.

Paths in this section are under `tools/inference-playground/src/runtime/`.
The reviewed NativeClosureEnvironment construction already establishes finite
nearest-binder lookup, old-environment address stability and fresh Store.push
observation. `machine.rs:2585–2638` is the actual lookup/append/bind owner.

cell address, and the Name consumer at 781–862 reads its CURRENT ReceivedValue.
Cells can be filled after closure formation, including recursive initialization.

The native function named `substitute_environment` at 2606 is not syntactic
value substitution. It composes dictionary dispatch substitutions and optionally
appends a binder-free environment node. It neither rewrites code nor replaces
lexical values. The new de Bruijn substitution is a mathematical interpretation
of successful lexical capture; its native adequacy requires the source layout
and current-cell relation. Conflating these two operations would leave the
central body/environment premise unproved.

`ReceivedValue` at machine.rs:165 contains value handle, interface, receiving
view and optional dispatch. New generic Store cells contain already represented

## 4. Callee-first Apply and entry modes

`program.rs:852–857` retains both callee and argument code labels. Native
`Instruction::Apply` at machine.rs:888–900 evaluates callee after pushing the
argument and caller environment. `Frame::Callee` at 1181–1201 allocates an inert
Delay of the whole argument in the CALLER environment, then selects the actual
returned executable. The closure branch at 1224–1329 enters the SAVED closure
environment after dispatch substitution. The previous inventory covers each field.

The corresponding research computation is structurally

```
bind callee (dynamicCall (var 0) (delay (rename argument Nat.succ)))
```

Here `argument` is a computation typed in the original surrounding context.
The shift places every original free value index beyond the new callee binder;
all binders within argument code lift that shift. This construction retains an
inert delay rather than placing argument execution before the callee bind.
Its theorem proves typing of this actual term. It is not a complete source Apply
elaboration or a proof about native request/suffix traces.

Value entry pushes ValueEntry and executes the delayed argument; when it returns,
ordinary parameter binding at machine.rs:1476 uses that received value. A typed

at 1298–1329 binds the carrier itself at Thunk A and immediately evaluates its

There is no extra force in that construction. A body may later force its formal.

`Frame::ValueEntry:1438–1488` also validates callback schema/owner/identity/interface,
handles unit patterns without an ordinary parameter cell, and delegates record
patterns. `RecordDefault:1489–1498` and `bind_record_parameter:2655–2689` preserve
sequential field/default scope. These cases require source pattern/body elaboration

The accepted old formal entry supplier is `CallEntryTypingRepair.lean`;

Accordingly, typed body projections are computations inside the research model,

## Syntax and quantifiers

domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,

type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual

import YulangClosure.HigherOrderSubstitution
import YulangClosure.HigherOrderEmbedding

namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Environment
open YulangClosure.NativeClosureEnvironment
open YulangClosure.CallEnvironmentRealization (Reference address)

abbrev Layout (K : Type) := List (Reference K × Ty)

def read [DecidableEq K] (arena : Arena K D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Nat → Option Value) (ref : Reference K) : Option Value :=
  readEmbedded arena env store ref

/-- This genuinely runs the finite lookup/read sequence. Any failed read aborts. -/
def realize [DecidableEq K] (arena : Arena K D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Nat → Option Value) : Layout K → Option (List Value)
  | [] => some []
  | (ref, _) :: rest => do
      let value ← read arena env store ref
      let values ← realize arena env store rest
      pure (value :: values)

def context : Layout K → Context
  | [], _ => none
  | (_, ty) :: _, 0 => some ty
  | _ :: rest, n + 1 => context rest n

/-- Filler occurs only outside the represented finite context. -/
def substitution (filler : Value) : List Value → Nat → Value
  | [], _ => filler
  | value :: _, 0 => value
  | _ :: rest, n + 1 => substitution filler rest n

inductive Captured (readValue : Reference K → Option Value) : Layout K → List Value → Prop where
  | nil : Captured readValue [] []
  | cons : readValue ref = some value → Captured readValue rest values →
      Captured readValue ((ref, ty) :: rest) (value :: values)

theorem realize_captured [DecidableEq K] (arena : Arena K D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Nat → Option Value) (layout : Layout K) (values : List Value)
    (h : realize arena env store layout = some values) :
    Captured (read arena env store) layout values := by
  induction layout generalizing values with
  | nil => simp [realize] at h; subst values; exact .nil
  | cons head rest ih =>
      rcases head with ⟨ref, ty⟩
      cases hr : read arena env store ref with
      | none => simp [realize, hr] at h
      | some value =>
          cases ht : realize arena env store rest with
          | none => simp [realize, hr, ht] at h
          | some tail =>
              simp [realize, hr, ht] at h
              subst values
              exact .cons hr (ih tail ht)

/-- Every typed free index sees a successful actual read, never the filler. -/
theorem captured_index {readValue : Reference K → Option Value}
    {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value} (h : Captured readValue layout values)
    (filler : Value) (i : Nat) (ty : Ty) (hi : context layout i = some ty) :
    ∃ ref, (ref, ty) ∈ layout ∧ readValue ref = some (substitution filler values i) := by
  induction h generalizing i with
  | nil => cases hi
  | @cons ref value rest values a hr ht ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp only [context, Option.some.injEq] at hi
          subst ty
          exact ⟨ref, by simp, hr⟩
      | succ i =>
          obtain ⟨r, hm, hv⟩ := ih i hi
          exact ⟨r, by simp [hm], hv⟩

/-- The per-cell typing obligation is explicit and restricted to layout entries
and successful addresses/current reads. Arbitrary stores need not be typed. -/
def CellsTyped [DecidableEq K] (arena : Arena K D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Nat → Option Value) (layout : Layout K) : Prop :=
  ∀ ref ty, (ref, ty) ∈ layout → ∀ cell value,
    address arena env ref = some cell → store cell = some value →
    ValueTyped emptyContext value ty

theorem successful_read_typed [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} (hc : CellsTyped arena env store layout)
    {ref : Reference K} {ty : Ty} (hm : (ref, ty) ∈ layout)
    {value : Value} (hr : read arena env store ref = some value) :
    ValueTyped emptyContext value ty := by
  cases ha : address arena env ref with
  | none => simp [read, readEmbedded, ha] at hr
  | some cell =>
      have hs : store cell = some value := by simpa [read, readEmbedded, ha] using hr
      exact hc ref ty hm cell value ha hs

theorem realized_substitution_typed [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value}
    (success : realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CellsTyped arena env store layout) (filler : Value) :
    ∀ i ty, context layout i = some ty →
      ValueTyped emptyContext (substitution filler values i) ty := by
  intro i ty hi
  obtain ⟨ref, hm, hr⟩ := captured_index
    (realize_captured arena env store layout values success) filler i ty hi
  exact successful_read_typed cells hm hr

/-- Parent application: actual successful capture construction supplies the
existing substitution theorem, including its bind and request lifting cases. -/
theorem close_body [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value}
    (success : realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CellsTyped arena env store layout) (filler : Value)
    {body : Comp} {result : Ty} (typed : CompTyped (context layout) body result) :
    CompTyped emptyContext (substComp (substitution filler values) body) result :=
  substComp_typed typed (realized_substitution_typed success cells filler)

/-- Capture closes the ambient environment while keeping a parameter binder.
The inserted callable values are shifted beneath that binder. -/
theorem close_bound_body [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value}
    (success : realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CellsTyped arena env store layout) (filler : Value)
    {body : Comp} {parameter result : Ty}
    (hb : CompTyped (extend (context layout) parameter) body result) :
    CompTyped (extend emptyContext parameter)
      (substComp (lift (substitution filler values)) body) result :=
  substComp_typed hb (lift_typed (realized_substitution_typed success cells filler) parameter)

theorem close_adapter [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value}
    (success : realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CellsTyped arena env store layout) (filler : Value)
    (ha : AdapterTyped (context layout) adapter a b) :
    AdapterTyped emptyContext (substAdapter (substitution filler values) adapter) a b :=
  substAdapter_typed ha (realized_substitution_typed success cells filler)

/-- A fresh global-reference witness is a formal address witness, not a claim
that a source ModuleDef identifier denotes this newly allocated cell. -/
def freshLayout (store : Store Value) (a : Ty) : Layout Nat :=
  [(.global store.size, a)]

theorem fresh_read (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat) (store : Store Value) (v : Value) :
    read arena env (store.push v).cell (.global store.size) = some v := by
  simp [read, readEmbedded, address, push_current]

theorem fresh_realize (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat) (store : Store Value) (v : Value) (a : Ty) :
    realize arena env (store.push v).cell (freshLayout store a) = some [v] := by
  simp [freshLayout, realize, fresh_read]

theorem fresh_cells (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat) (store : Store Value)
    (hv : ValueTyped emptyContext v a) :
    CellsTyped arena env (store.push v).cell (freshLayout store a) := by
  intro ref ty hm cell value ha hs
  simp only [freshLayout, List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at hm
  rcases hm with ⟨hr, ht⟩
  subst ref
  subst ty
  simp only [address, Option.some.injEq] at ha
  subst cell
  rw [push_current] at hs
  cases hs
  exact hv

/-- The cell premise is constructed, then fed to finite capture and substitution
for an arbitrary typed higher-order body. No arbitrary native cell typing axiom. -/
theorem fresh_function_closes {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (hf : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Store Value) (filler : Value) {body : Comp} {result : Ty}
    (hb : CompTyped (context (freshLayout store (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b)))) body result) :
    read arena env (store.push (embedFunction f)).cell (.global store.size) = some (embedFunction f) ∧
    realize arena env (store.push (embedFunction f)).cell
      (freshLayout store (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b))) = some [embedFunction f] ∧
    CompTyped emptyContext (substComp (substitution filler [embedFunction f]) body) result := by
  exact ⟨fresh_read _ _ _ _, fresh_realize _ _ _ _ _,
    close_body (fresh_realize _ _ _ _ _) (fresh_cells _ _ _ (embedFunction_typed hf _)) filler hb⟩

/-- Concrete consumer of the successful fresh capture: return the captured
callable, then allow it to be used as a delayed higher-order argument. -/
theorem fresh_function_return {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (hf : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Store Value) (filler : Value) :
    CompTyped emptyContext (.ret (embedFunction f)) (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b)) := by
  have hb : CompTyped (context (freshLayout store (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b))))
      (.ret (.var 0)) (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b)) := .ret (.var rfl)
  exact close_body (fresh_realize arena env store (embedFunction f) _)
    (fresh_cells arena env store (embedFunction_typed hf _)) filler hb

theorem fresh_function_argument {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (hf : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Store Value) (filler : Value) :
    ValueTyped emptyContext (.delay (.ret (embedFunction f)))
      (.thunk (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b))) :=
  .delay (fresh_function_return hf arena env store filler)

/-- Lexical capture selects the same freshly allocated current callable cell. -/
theorem fresh_lexical_read [DecidableEq K] (old : Arena K D) (parent : Nat)
    (key : K) (dispatch : D) (store : Store Value) (v : Value) :
    read (.append old parent (some (key, store.size)) dispatch) old.size
      (store.push v).cell (.lexical key) = some v := by
  simp [read, readEmbedded, address, parameter_shadows, push_current]

end YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Environment

import YulangClosure.HigherOrderSubstitution
import YulangClosure.HigherOrderEmbedding

namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Environment
open YulangClosure.NativeClosureEnvironment
open YulangClosure.CallEnvironmentRealization (Reference address)

abbrev Layout (K : Type) := List (Reference K × Ty)

def read [DecidableEq K] (arena : Arena K D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Nat → Option Value) (ref : Reference K) : Option Value :=
  readEmbedded arena env store ref

/-- This genuinely runs the finite lookup/read sequence. Any failed read aborts. -/
def realize [DecidableEq K] (arena : Arena K D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Nat → Option Value) : Layout K → Option (List Value)
  | [] => some []
  | (ref, _) :: rest => do
      let value ← read arena env store ref
      let values ← realize arena env store rest
      pure (value :: values)

def context : Layout K → Context
  | [], _ => none
  | (_, ty) :: _, 0 => some ty
  | _ :: rest, n + 1 => context rest n

/-- Filler occurs only outside the represented finite context. -/
def substitution (filler : Value) : List Value → Nat → Value
  | [], _ => filler
  | value :: _, 0 => value
  | _ :: rest, n + 1 => substitution filler rest n

inductive Captured (readValue : Reference K → Option Value) : Layout K → List Value → Prop where
  | nil : Captured readValue [] []
  | cons : readValue ref = some value → Captured readValue rest values →
      Captured readValue ((ref, ty) :: rest) (value :: values)

theorem realize_captured [DecidableEq K] (arena : Arena K D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Nat → Option Value) (layout : Layout K) (values : List Value)
    (h : realize arena env store layout = some values) :
    Captured (read arena env store) layout values := by
  induction layout generalizing values with
  | nil => simp [realize] at h; subst values; exact .nil
  | cons head rest ih =>
      rcases head with ⟨ref, ty⟩
      cases hr : read arena env store ref with
      | none => simp [realize, hr] at h
      | some value =>
          cases ht : realize arena env store rest with
          | none => simp [realize, hr, ht] at h
          | some tail =>
              simp [realize, hr, ht] at h
              subst values
              exact .cons hr (ih tail ht)

/-- Every typed free index sees a successful actual read, never the filler. -/
theorem captured_index {readValue : Reference K → Option Value}
    {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value} (h : Captured readValue layout values)
    (filler : Value) (i : Nat) (ty : Ty) (hi : context layout i = some ty) :
    ∃ ref, (ref, ty) ∈ layout ∧ readValue ref = some (substitution filler values i) := by
  induction h generalizing i with
  | nil => cases hi
  | @cons ref value rest values a hr ht ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp only [context, Option.some.injEq] at hi
          subst ty
          exact ⟨ref, by simp, hr⟩
      | succ i =>
          obtain ⟨r, hm, hv⟩ := ih i hi
          exact ⟨r, by simp [hm], hv⟩

/-- The per-cell typing obligation is explicit and restricted to layout entries
and successful addresses/current reads. Arbitrary stores need not be typed. -/
def CellsTyped [DecidableEq K] (arena : Arena K D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Nat → Option Value) (layout : Layout K) : Prop :=
  ∀ ref ty, (ref, ty) ∈ layout → ∀ cell value,
    address arena env ref = some cell → store cell = some value →
    ValueTyped emptyContext value ty

theorem successful_read_typed [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} (hc : CellsTyped arena env store layout)
    {ref : Reference K} {ty : Ty} (hm : (ref, ty) ∈ layout)
    {value : Value} (hr : read arena env store ref = some value) :
    ValueTyped emptyContext value ty := by
  cases ha : address arena env ref with
  | none => simp [read, readEmbedded, ha] at hr
  | some cell =>
      have hs : store cell = some value := by simpa [read, readEmbedded, ha] using hr
      exact hc ref ty hm cell value ha hs

theorem realized_substitution_typed [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value}
    (success : realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CellsTyped arena env store layout) (filler : Value) :
    ∀ i ty, context layout i = some ty →
      ValueTyped emptyContext (substitution filler values i) ty := by
  intro i ty hi
  obtain ⟨ref, hm, hr⟩ := captured_index
    (realize_captured arena env store layout values success) filler i ty hi
  exact successful_read_typed cells hm hr

/-- Parent application: actual successful capture construction supplies the
existing substitution theorem, including its bind and request lifting cases. -/
theorem close_body [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value}
    (success : realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CellsTyped arena env store layout) (filler : Value)
    {body : Comp} {result : Ty} (typed : CompTyped (context layout) body result) :
    CompTyped emptyContext (substComp (substitution filler values) body) result :=
  substComp_typed typed (realized_substitution_typed success cells filler)

/-- Capture closes the ambient environment while keeping a parameter binder.
The inserted callable values are shifted beneath that binder. -/
theorem close_bound_body [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value}
    (success : realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CellsTyped arena env store layout) (filler : Value)
    {body : Comp} {parameter result : Ty}
    (hb : CompTyped (extend (context layout) parameter) body result) :
    CompTyped (extend emptyContext parameter)
      (substComp (lift (substitution filler values)) body) result :=
  substComp_typed hb (lift_typed (realized_substitution_typed success cells filler) parameter)

theorem close_adapter [DecidableEq K] {arena : Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option Value} {layout : Layout K} {values : List Value}
    (success : realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CellsTyped arena env store layout) (filler : Value)
    (ha : AdapterTyped (context layout) adapter a b) :
    AdapterTyped emptyContext (substAdapter (substitution filler values) adapter) a b :=
  substAdapter_typed ha (realized_substitution_typed success cells filler)

/-- A fresh global-reference witness is a formal address witness, not a claim
that a source ModuleDef identifier denotes this newly allocated cell. -/
def freshLayout (store : Store Value) (a : Ty) : Layout Nat :=
  [(.global store.size, a)]

theorem fresh_read (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat) (store : Store Value) (v : Value) :
    read arena env (store.push v).cell (.global store.size) = some v := by
  simp [read, readEmbedded, address, push_current]

theorem fresh_realize (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat) (store : Store Value) (v : Value) (a : Ty) :
    realize arena env (store.push v).cell (freshLayout store a) = some [v] := by
  simp [freshLayout, realize, fresh_read]

theorem fresh_cells (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat) (store : Store Value)
    (hv : ValueTyped emptyContext v a) :
    CellsTyped arena env (store.push v).cell (freshLayout store a) := by
  intro ref ty hm cell value ha hs
  simp only [freshLayout, List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at hm
  rcases hm with ⟨hr, ht⟩
  subst ref
  subst ty
  simp only [address, Option.some.injEq] at ha
  subst cell
  rw [push_current] at hs
  cases hs
  exact hv

/-- The cell premise is constructed, then fed to finite capture and substitution
for an arbitrary typed higher-order body. No arbitrary native cell typing axiom. -/
theorem fresh_function_closes {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (hf : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Store Value) (filler : Value) {body : Comp} {result : Ty}
    (hb : CompTyped (context (freshLayout store (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b)))) body result) :
    read arena env (store.push (embedFunction f)).cell (.global store.size) = some (embedFunction f) ∧
    realize arena env (store.push (embedFunction f)).cell
      (freshLayout store (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b))) = some [embedFunction f] ∧
    CompTyped emptyContext (substComp (substitution filler [embedFunction f]) body) result := by
  exact ⟨fresh_read arena env store _, fresh_realize arena env store _ _,
    close_body (fresh_realize arena env store _ _)
      (fresh_cells arena env store (embedFunction_typed hf _)) filler hb⟩

/-- Concrete consumer of the successful fresh capture: return the captured
callable, then allow it to be used as a delayed higher-order argument. -/
theorem fresh_function_return {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (hf : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Store Value) (filler : Value) :
    CompTyped emptyContext (.ret (embedFunction f)) (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b)) := by
  have hb : CompTyped (context (freshLayout store (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b))))
      (.ret (.var 0)) (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b)) := .ret (.var rfl)
  exact close_body (fresh_realize arena env store (embedFunction f) _)
    (fresh_cells arena env store (embedFunction_typed hf _)) filler hb

theorem fresh_function_argument {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (hf : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) (arena : Arena Nat D) (env : Nat)
    (store : Store Value) (filler : Value) :
    ValueTyped emptyContext (.delay (.ret (embedFunction f)))
      (.thunk (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b))) :=
  .delay (fresh_function_return hf arena env store filler)

/-- Lexical capture selects the same freshly allocated current callable cell. -/
theorem fresh_lexical_read [DecidableEq K] (old : Arena K D) (parent : Nat)
    (key : K) (dispatch : D) (store : Store Value) (v : Value) :
    read (.append old parent (some (key, store.size)) dispatch) old.size
      (store.push v).cell (.lexical key) = some v := by
  simp [read, readEmbedded, address, parameter_shadows, push_current]

end YulangClosure.HigherOrder.Environment

Date: 2026-10-25
Baseline: `98118c2933694a03fcbf443a4cd638e350f76394`.
Scope: checked research core typing constructions; full source/native adequacy OPEN.
Contract: `tasks/agent-loop/sprints/higher-order-substitution-entry-20261025-r1.md`.
Verification and independent review are recorded in the sprint outcome/receipts.
The previous independently reviewed constructor inventory is
`notes/theory/2026-10-25-higher-order-source-constructor-map.md`; its exact bytes
and all native source dependencies are pinned in this contract.

## 1. New parent application and its limit

The preceding milestone embedded old Functions as genuine HigherOrder.Value
callables. This packet supplies capture-avoiding substitution for the entire
higher-order grammar, then consumes a constructed callable in an actual generic
current-cell read, finite capture realization and body-closing operation. The
selected endpoint must discharge that constructed store's cell typing using
`embedFunction_typed`, rather than assume arbitrary native cells are typed.

The general theorem remains conditional on successful current reads, a correct
finite layout and typing of those represented current values. The concrete
fresh-cell/callable application supplies its read and cell-typing hypotheses.
This is a real instance of the new supplier, not readback of a Rust Closure.
The source-to-layout map, native ReceivedValue interpretation and shared/recursive
closure graph are distinct OPEN premises. A direct cell Reference used for a
fresh generic store address does not assert that a local cell is a source
ModuleDef or belongs to the native preallocated global definition table.

## 2. Exact binder ownership

The immutable accepted HigherOrder typing rules are the authority for these
research algebraic proofs. The syntax contains value-variable binders only;
this packet does not claim type-variable/polymorphic substitution or full Raw
binder coverage. Value substitution leaves types and operation instances intact,
including every ordered type argument, receipt, path and view occurrence.

| Position | Environment used by its typing rule | Transformation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lambda body, Value mode | extend outer A | Lift through one parameter binder. |
| lambda body, Computation mode | extend outer (Thunk A) | Same index lifting, distinct bound type. |
| lambda result consumer | outer | Transform the Adapter in the outer substitution; no lambda-parameter lift. |
| Adapter body | extend outer input | Adapter itself introduces exactly one input binder. |
| bind body | extend outer first-result | Lift once; first computation uses outer substitution. |
| unionCase branches | extend outer left / extend outer right | Lift each branch separately. |
| request continuation | extend outer response type | Lift once; payload uses outer substitution. |
| wrap inner/input/output | outer | Inner value and both adapters use the same outer substitution; adapter bodies lift themselves. |
| delay, view, scope, expose, dynamicCall | outer | Recurse through their actual value/code children, retaining metadata. |

The critical nested-lambda case has two different index-zero meanings. Index zero
inside the lambda body is its parameter; index zero inside its consumer's body
is the consumer input. The consumer does not capture the lambda parameter. For
example, an outer value referenced by index one in each body is replaced once
in each case; lifting the consumer once for the lambda and again for the adapter
would mistakenly retain or capture the wrong variable.

Closed Original nodes in old TypedCall syntax were protected from old Call
rename/substitution. The new structural embedding exposes their internal terms.
Thus an untyped old `.original (.var 0)` is a concrete counterexample to an
unconditional old/new commuting equation: old Call substitution leaves it intact,
while target substitution changes its image `.var 0`. Old typing excludes that
open Original term through its empty-context premise. No accepted old theorem
is weakened, and no unrestricted commuting theorem is asserted here.

## 3. Native lookup and substitution are different operations

Paths in this section are under `tools/inference-playground/src/runtime/`.
The reviewed NativeClosureEnvironment construction already establishes finite
nearest-binder lookup, old-environment address stability and fresh Store.push
observation. `machine.rs:2585–2638` is the actual lookup/append/bind owner.
Lookup follows immutable parent indices to a full binder identity, returns a
cell address, and the Name consumer at 781–862 reads its CURRENT ReceivedValue.
Cells can be filled after closure formation, including recursive initialization.

The native function named `substitute_environment` at 2606 is not syntactic
value substitution. It composes dictionary dispatch substitutions and optionally
appends a binder-free environment node. It neither rewrites code nor replaces
lexical values. The new de Bruijn substitution is a mathematical interpretation
of successful lexical capture; its native adequacy requires the source layout
and current-cell relation. Conflating these two operations would leave the
central body/environment premise unproved.

`ReceivedValue` at machine.rs:165 contains value handle, interface, receiving
view and optional dispatch. New generic Store cells contain already represented
HigherOrder.Value. A proof about the latter does not erase or validate the former
fields. Their source representation/typing remains ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 and
ENV-DISPATCH-1; finite lexical addresses alone do not solve recursive value graphs.

## 4. Callee-first Apply and entry modes

`program.rs:852–857` retains both callee and argument code labels. Native
`Instruction::Apply` at machine.rs:888–900 evaluates callee after pushing the
argument and caller environment. `Frame::Callee` at 1181–1201 allocates an inert
Delay of the whole argument in the CALLER environment, then selects the actual
returned executable. The closure branch at 1224–1329 enters the SAVED closure
environment after dispatch substitution. The previous inventory covers each field.

The corresponding research computation is structurally

```
bind callee (dynamicCall (var 0) (delay (rename argument Nat.succ)))
```

Here `argument` is a computation typed in the original surrounding context.
The shift places every original free value index beyond the new callee binder;
all binders within argument code lift that shift. This construction retains an
inert delay rather than placing argument execution before the callee bind.
Its theorem proves typing of this actual term. It is not a complete source Apply
elaboration or a proof about native request/suffix traces.

Value entry pushes ValueEntry and executes the delayed argument; when it returns,
ordinary parameter binding at machine.rs:1476 uses that received value. A typed
force/bind composition models this formal body's A parameter. Computation entry
at 1298–1329 binds the carrier itself at Thunk A and immediately evaluates its
body; formal substitution of the UNFORCED carrier models that body entry.
There is no extra force in that construction. A body may later force its formal.

`Frame::ValueEntry:1438–1488` also validates callback schema/owner/identity/interface,
handles unit patterns without an ordinary parameter cell, and delegates record
patterns. `RecordDefault:1489–1498` and `bind_record_parameter:2655–2689` preserve
sequential field/default scope. These cases require source pattern/body elaboration
and metadata evidence before a single-binder formal body applies. The research
proof adds no source restriction and does not silently claim those checks succeed.

## 5. Result consumers and wrap projections

The accepted old formal entry supplier is `CallEntryTypingRepair.lean`;
`CallPeelingTyping.lean` tracks wrap argument delays and ordered result adapters.
The historical failed `CallEntryTyping.lean` is not an accepted proof dependency.
The new higher-order constructions use the actual Adapter body under its own
input binder and preserve the c→a argument / b→d result directions around a→b.
A delayed input-adapter composition must remain under delay; result consumption
follows the invocation body's result. Existing receipt, paths and captured views
remain attached to the retained adapter/entry plan.

Native `ExecutableValue` has Closure/Delay/Request/Continuation/Primitive cases,
not a direct Wrap case. There is no established all-source map from every formal
wrap/result consumer to that native enumeration. `Frame::ReceiverReturn` at
machine.rs:1430–1437 leaves the invocation owner and transports the returned
ReceivedValue; this fact alone does not execute or certify an arbitrary formal
result adapter. Correspondence with actual source-generated adapter plans and
receiving/dispatch transitions remains OPEN.

Accordingly, typed body projections are computations inside the research model,
with full original adapter/receipt data retained by their plan. No body-typing
lemma grants runtime metadata erasure, supplies fresh invocation/receipt identities,
or proves owner retirement, continuation replay or dispatch error exclusion.
The paper remains a proposal; no new production semantics is adopted.

## 6. Remaining gates and next concrete consumers

- HO-SUBSTITUTION-1 can close for the accepted HigherOrder finite grammar only
  after all mutual cases and lifts check and pass independent review.
- The constructed callable-cell/body theorem supplies one genuine instance of
  ENV-CALLABLE-1's body-closing input. Arbitrary native Closure/Delay current-cell
  readback, complete layouts and recursive graphs remain ENV-LAYOUT-1,
  ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 and ENV-GRAPH-1, at program/body/initialization owners.
- Typed force/bind, computation entry, consumer/wrap and source Apply expressions
  are not a full HigherOrder operational machine. Progress/preservation for
  actual transitions and all source/native trace correspondence remain OPEN.
- ENV-DISPATCH-1 and RESPONSE-TEMPLATE-1 still require typed receiving/dispatch/
  frame interpretation and errors exclusion beyond the reviewed structural
  environment/template suppliers. Force and original inference A/B retain their
  original scope and owners.

NO_SAFE_CODE_SLICE: the inspected Callee and ValueEntry/Computation owners expose
no demonstrated runtime defect. No compiler/runtime/expectation/config change or
native test is authorized by this proof packet.
